name: Advisor Intelligence PII Pseudonymization + RBAC
description: Fortify advisor-intelligence API with server-side RBAC and PII pseudonymization. Phase 0 (hotfix): auth-validator-edge blocks non-admin from advisor-intelligence paths (403). Phase 1: design pseudonymization layer (HMAC hashing at serving layer, role-graduated visibility). Phase 2: implement graduated RBAC (opal-capital admin=cleartext, opal-capital user=pseudonymized, 49F advisor=own-book-only, 49F admin=firm-cleartext). Phase 3: deploy and validate. Gold layer stays cleartext; pseudonymization happens at Lambda@Edge origin-response or API response layer.
